- Maria's traditional IRA: $70,000 on December 31, 2025. All pre-tax (no after-tax basis).
- Glen's Roth IRA: $25,000 on December 31, 2025. First Roth contribution in 2014.
- Maria's Roth IRA: $15,000 on December 31, 2025. First Roth contribution in 2016.
- Joint savings (cash) account: $390,000 on December 31, 2025.
- Joint brokerage account: $460,000 on December 31, 2025. Cost basis $319,000; dividends 1.5% of the opening balance each year, 75% of them qualified; all holdings long-term.
- Glen's pension (fully taxable): $28,000 a year from 2026, no raises.
- Spending: $117,000 a year after tax in 2026 dollars, rising with inflation. Federal tax and Medicare premiums are paid on top of this.
- Paid out of that spending each year (2026 dollars, rising with inflation): property tax $4,200. No other deductible expenses.
- Their 2024 MAGI (for Medicare IRMAA) was $126,000, on a joint return.
- Their 2025 MAGI (for Medicare IRMAA) was $116,000, on a joint return.
